identity: A developer workspace with task-specific lists, details, and controls for reviewing code, retrying jobs, inspecting logs and records, and changing feature rules.

scenarios.name: prcomment
scenarios.screen: A pull-request diff shows a file and its numbered code lines, with controls for adding a line comment and approving the review. The requested comment has not been posted, and the review is not approved.
never: The requested line comment already posted.
A merge confirmation open before any review action.

arrangements.text: The file heading sits above the diff, with line numbers beside the code and review controls below it.
The diff occupies the left side of the task area, with the comment editor and review controls on the right.

scenarios.name: rerun
scenarios.screen: A pipeline view shows a graph or list of jobs, including a failed job, with job status and retry controls. The failed job has no new retry attempt yet.
never: The requested job already retried successfully.
A new retry attempt already listed.
A deploy confirmation open before the retry control is used.

arrangements.text: The pipeline jobs run across the task area, with each job's status beside its name and the selected job's controls beneath the graph.
The jobs form a vertical list on the left, with the selected job's status and retry control on the right.

scenarios.name: logs
scenarios.screen: A log explorer shows search, service, and severity controls above timestamped event rows. The search is empty, no event is selected for investigation, and the event details are closed.
never: The requested event already marked for investigation.
A search query already filled with the requested message.
A selected event's detail panel open on load.

arrangements.text: Search and filter controls sit above the log rows, with timestamps and event messages aligned across each row.
Search and filter controls sit to the left of the log list, with event details opening beside the list after selection.

scenarios.name: dbrow
scenarios.screen: A database inspector shows account records with their identifiers and saved values, including quota limits. A quota editor and save control are available, and the requested new quota has not been saved.
never: The requested quota already saved in the record.
A save confirmation open on load.
An unrelated database table shown in place of accounts.

arrangements.text: Account rows occupy the left side, with the selected record's fields and save control on the right.
Account rows sit above a record form, with the quota field and save control below the other fields.

scenarios.name: flag
scenarios.screen: A feature-management view shows flags, environment and segment selectors, and a control for the selected scope's enabled state. The requested scoped change has not been saved.
never: The requested scope already showing the newly saved setting.
A configuration version increment caused by the requested change.
A confirmation dialog open before the setting is changed.

arrangements.text: Flags appear in a list on the left, with environment and segment selectors above the selected flag's state control on the right.
Environment and segment selectors sit above a flag list, with each flag's state control beside its name.
